topic: MSS / Major inspections, survey, reporting, and works
syllabus_extract: MSS / Major inspections, survey, reporting, and works
specific_objectives: 1.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate various servicing schedules on naval aircraft and defect reporting procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of MSS schedule charts and defect reporting forms; Instructor supervision of form filling accuracy
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between a routine check and a Major Structural Survey?
List three types of servicing schedules found in naval aircraft maintenance manuals.
Why is immediate defect reporting critical for flight safety?

development.content:
Definition and scope of MSS
Frequency of Major inspections
Survey procedures and documentation
Reporting requirements and timelines
Work authorization and release

Servicing schedules enumeration
Defect identification criteria
Reporting procedure steps
Form A-26 overview
Chain of command for defects

Survey completion protocols
Rectification work initiation
Final inspection and sign-off
Record keeping standards
Preparation for next inspection

summary_questions: Explain the sequence of actions required when a major defect is identified during a survey.
How does the servicing schedule determine the interval for the next MSS?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the defect reporting procedure to be discussed in the next lesson on Defect rectification, reporting and recording, instruction for use of form A-26 (latest version).

pft_rows.syllabus: Defect rectification, reporting and recording, instruction for use of form A-26 (latest version).
